title: About
text: Environmental Consultant with 8 years of experience delivering Environmental & Social Impact Assessment (ESIA), Environmental & Social Due Diligence (ESDD), and climate-related advisory services (ESG baseline development, GHG inventories, and climate risk analysis) across renewable energy, power, manufacturing, and Merger & Acquisition transactions. Hands-on experience across Asia-Pacific markets, complemented by EU academic training in sustainable development. Proven track record supporting clients in alignment with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards, Equator Principles (EP4), and ISO frameworks.

title: Truc Pham
text:
What I do


Impact Assessment
ESIA and ESMP for wind, solar, gas and LNG-to-power projects, aligned with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards and Equator Principles.


Due Diligence & ESG
ESDD, ESG DD and EHS DD for M&A transactions and manufacturing assets, turning site findings into clear, investment-ready action plans.


Climate & Carbon
GHG inventories (GHG Protocol), TCFD climate risk assessments, CSRD/ESRS baselines, and carbon footprint analysis with R and GIS.


Based in Warsaw, Poland · MSc in Sustainable Development (with Distinction), University of Warsaw
